contea di ritrovamento: Greater London (Inghilterra e Galles)

A Medieval silver penny of Edward the Confessor, (AD 1042-1066) dating from AD 1059-1062, Moneyer Ælfwig, mint of Oxford. North type c No. 828. Obverse description: Crowned bust right, to flan, bearded with Sceptre in front. Obverse inscription: +EADWARD REX. Reverse description: Short cross voided with each limb terminating in an incurved segment of a circle with pellets at the terminals.…
